    | nil => simp
    | cons g gs ih =>
      rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, gateStep_length, List.length_cons]
      omega

  have indexed_value {α : Type} (op : GateOp → List α → α) (dflt : α) (gs : List Gate) (ws : List α) (j : ℕ) (g : Gate)
      (hj : gs[j]? = some g) (hback : ∀ i ∈ g.inputs, i < ws.length + j) :
      (gs.foldl (gateStep op dflt) ws).getD (ws.length + j) dflt =
        op g.op (g.inputs.map fun i => (gs.foldl (gateStep op dflt) ws).getD i dflt) := by
    induction gs generalizing ws j with
    | nil => simp at hj
    | cons g0 gs ih =>
      cases j with
      | zero =>
        simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hj
        subst g0
        rw [Nat.add_zero, List.foldl_cons, prefix_value _ _ _ _ _ (by rw [gateStep_length]; omega)]
        have hstep : (gateStep op dflt ws g).getD ws.length dflt =
            op g.op (g.inputs.map fun i => ws.getD i dflt) := by
          simp only [gateStep, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
          rw [List.getElem?_append_right (le_refl ws.length)]
          simp
        rw [hstep]
        congr 1
        apply List.map_congr_left
        intro i hi
        have hlt : i < ws.length := by simpa using hback i hi
        rw [prefix_value _ _ _ _ _ (by rw [gateStep_length]; omega)]
        simp only [gateStep, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_left hlt]
      | succ j =>
        simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at hj
        rw [List.foldl_cons]
        have hidx : ws.length + (j + 1) = (gateStep op dflt ws g0).length + j := by
          rw [gateStep_length]
          omega
        rw [hidx]
        exact ih (gateStep op dflt ws g0) j hj (by simpa only [hidx] using hback)

  let Valid (n : ℕ) (C : Circuit) : Prop :=
    ∀ j g, C.gates[j]? = some g →
      (g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or) ∧ ∃ a b : ℕ,
        g.inputs = [a,b] ∧ a ≠ b ∧ a < n + j ∧ b < n + j

  let val {n : ℕ} (C : Circuit) (x : Fin n → Bool) (i : ℕ) : Bool :=
    (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD i false

  have val_input {n : ℕ} (C : Circuit) (x : Fin n → Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
      val C x i = x ⟨i,hi⟩ := by
    have hi' : i < (List.ofFn x).length := by simpa using hi
    change (C.gates.foldl (gateStep GateOp.eval false) (List.ofFn x)).getD i false = _
    rw [prefix_value _ _ _ _ _ hi', List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi', List.getElem_ofFn]

  have val_outside {n : ℕ} (C : Circuit) (x : Fin n → Bool) (i : ℕ)
      (hi : n + C.gates.length ≤ i) : val C x i = false := by
    change (C.gates.foldl (gateStep GateOp.eval false) (List.ofFn x)).getD i false = false
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none]
    · rfl
    · simpa only [wireCount, List.length_ofFn] using hi

  have val_gate {n : ℕ} (C : Circuit) (x : Fin n → Bool) (j : ℕ) (g : Gate)
      (hj : C.gates[j]? = some g) (a b : ℕ) (hg : g.inputs = [a,b])
      (ha : a < n + j) (hb : b < n + j) :
      (g.op = .and → val C x (n + j) = (val C x a && val C x b)) ∧
      (g.op = .or → val C x (n + j) = (val C x a || val C x b)) := by
    have hback : ∀ i ∈ g.inputs, i < (List.ofFn x).length + j := by
      simp only [hg, List.length_ofFn, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
      rintro i (rfl | rfl) <;> assumption
    have hv := indexed_value GateOp.eval false C.gates (List.ofFn x) j g hj hback
    simp only [List.length_ofFn, hg, List.map_cons, List.map_nil] at hv
    constructor
    · intro ho
      rw [ho] at hv
      change val C x (n+j) = (val C x a && (val C x b && true)) at hv
      simpa only [Bool.and_true] using hv
    · intro ho
      rw [ho] at hv
      change val C x (n+j) = (val C x a || (val C x b || false)) at hv
      simpa only [Bool.or_false] using hv

  let oneInput (n z : ℕ) : Fin n → Bool :=
    fun i => decide (i.val = z)

  let twoInputs (n p l : ℕ) : Fin n → Bool :=
    fun i => decide (i.val = p ∨ i.val = l)

  let LinearTrace (n : ℕ) (C : Circuit) (other repeated : ℕ) (R : ℕ → Bool) : Prop :=
    (∀ i < n, R i = decide (i = repeated)) ∧
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (g : Gate) (a b : ℕ), C.gates[j]? = some g → g.inputs = [a,b] →
      (g.op = .and →
        R (n + j) =
          ((val C (oneInput n other) a && R b) || (R a && val C (oneInput n other) b))) ∧
      (g.op = .or → R (n + j) = (R a || R b))


  have flagTransitive (p l : Fin 13)
      (h : p - l ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13))) :
      ∃ (α β : Equiv.Perm (Fin 13)),
        α p = 0 ∧ β l = 0 ∧
        ∀ u t, (α u - β t ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13))) ↔
          u - t ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)) := by
    let offsets : Finset (Fin 13) := {0, 1, 3, 9}
    let P₁ : Fin 13 → Fin 13 := ![1, 0, 4, 3, 5, 6, 11, 8, 10, 9, 7, 12, 2]
    let L₁ : Fin 13 → Fin 13 := ![0, 4, 3, 2, 5, 10, 8, 7, 9, 6, 11, 12, 1]
    let P₃ : Fin 13 → Fin 13 := ![1, 3, 2, 0, 11, 12, 6, 7, 4, 9, 5, 8, 10]
    let L₃ : Fin 13 → Fin 13 := ![0, 2, 12, 10, 11, 3, 6, 4, 8, 9, 5, 7, 1]
    let P₉ : Fin 13 → Fin 13 := ![1, 3, 2, 9, 5, 6, 12, 8, 4, 0, 11, 7, 10]
    let L₉ : Fin 13 → Fin 13 := ![0, 2, 6, 9, 5, 3, 12, 8, 4, 10, 11, 7, 1]
    let e (f : Fin 13 → Fin 13) (hf : ∀ i j, f i = f j → i = j) : Equiv.Perm (Fin 13) :=
      Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨hf, Finite.injective_iff_surjective.mp hf⟩
    have h₁ : ∀ i j, P₁ i - L₁ j ∈ offsets ↔ i - j ∈ offsets := by decide
    have h₃ : ∀ i j, P₃ i - L₃ j ∈ offsets ↔ i - j ∈ offsets := by decide
    have h₉ : ∀ i j, P₉ i - L₉ j ∈ offsets ↔ i - j ∈ offsets := by decide
    have normalize : ∀ d ∈ offsets, ∃ (α β : Equiv.Perm (Fin 13)),
        α d = 0 ∧ β 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ u t, α u - β t ∈ offsets ↔ u - t ∈ offsets := by
      intro d hd
      change d ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)) at hd
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hd
      rcases hd with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨Equiv.refl _, Equiv.refl _, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨e P₁ (by decide), e L₁ (by decide), rfl, rfl, h₁⟩
      · exact ⟨e P₃ (by decide), e L₃ (by decide), rfl, rfl, h₃⟩
      · exact ⟨e P₉ (by decide), e L₉ (by decide), rfl, rfl, h₉⟩
    obtain ⟨α, β, hp, hl, hpres⟩ := normalize (p-l) h
    refine ⟨(Equiv.subRight l).trans α, (Equiv.subRight l).trans β, hp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change β (l - l) = 0
      simpa only [sub_self] using hl
    · intro u t
      change α (u-l) - β (t-l) ∈ offsets ↔ u - t ∈ offsets
      rw [hpres]
      rw [show (u-l) - (t-l) = u - t by abel]

  let Offsets : Finset (Fin 13) := {0, 1, 3, 9}
  let Computes (C : Circuit) : Prop :=
    ∀ x : Fin 26 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔
      ∃ u t : Fin 13, u - t ∈ Offsets ∧
        x (Fin.castAdd 13 u) = true ∧ x (Fin.natAdd 13 t) = true
  have normalizeCircuit (C : Circuit) (p l : Fin 13) (R S : ℕ → Bool)
      (hmax : C.size ≤ 64) (hC : Valid 26 C) (hI : Computes C)
      (hpl : p - l ∈ Offsets)
      (hR : LinearTrace 26 C p.val (13 + l.val) R)
      (hS : LinearTrace 26 C (13 + l.val) p.val S) :
      ∃ D : Circuit, 63 ≤ D.size ∧ D.size ≤ 64 ∧ Valid 26 D ∧ Computes D ∧
        (∃ R', LinearTrace 26 D 0 13 R' ∧ R' D.output = R C.output) ∧
        (∃ S', LinearTrace 26 D 13 0 S' ∧ S' D.output = S C.output) := by
    obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hab⟩ := flagTransitive p l hpl
    let join : Fin 13 ⊕ Fin 13 ≃ Fin 26 := finSumFinEquiv
    let e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 26) := join.symm.trans ((Equiv.sumCongr α β).trans join)
    have heP (u : Fin 13) : e (Fin.castAdd 13 u) = Fin.castAdd 13 (α u) := by
      have hu : join (.inl u) = Fin.castAdd 13 u := finSumFinEquiv_apply_left u
      have hv : join (.inl (α u)) = Fin.castAdd 13 (α u) := finSumFinEquiv_apply_left (α u)
      rw [← hu, ← hv]
      simp [e]
    have heL (t : Fin 13) : e (Fin.natAdd 13 t) = Fin.natAdd 13 (β t) := by
      have ht : join (.inr t) = Fin.natAdd 13 t := finSumFinEquiv_apply_right t
      have hv : join (.inr (β t)) = Fin.natAdd 13 (β t) := finSumFinEquiv_apply_right (β t)
      rw [← ht, ← hv]
      simp [e]

    let relabel (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin 26)) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
      if hi : i < 26 then (f ⟨i, hi⟩).val else i
    let q := relabel e
    let r := relabel e.symm
    have label_input (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin 26)) (i : Fin 26) : relabel f i.val = (f i).val :=
      dite_eq_left i.isLt
    have label_gate (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin 26)) {i : ℕ} (hi : 26 ≤ i) : relabel f i = i :=
      dite_eq_right (Nat.not_lt.mpr hi)
    have label_lt (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin 26)) (i b : ℕ) (hb : 26 ≤ b) :
        relabel f i < b ↔ i < b := by
      by_cases hi : i < 26
      · rw [label_input f (⟨i,hi⟩ : Fin 26)]
        exact iff_of_true (lt_of_lt_of_le (f ⟨i,hi⟩).isLt hb) (lt_of_lt_of_le hi hb)
      · rw [label_gate f (Nat.le_of_not_gt hi)]
    have label_inverse (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin 26)) (i : ℕ) :
        relabel f.symm (relabel f i) = i := by
      by_cases hi : i < 26
      · rw [label_input f (⟨i,hi⟩ : Fin 26), label_input, f.symm_apply_apply]
      · have hi' := Nat.le_of_not_gt hi
        rw [label_gate f hi', label_gate f.symm hi']
    have hrq (i : ℕ) : r (q i) = i := label_inverse e i
    have hqr (i : ℕ) : q (r i) = i := label_inverse e.symm i
    have hqinj : Function.Injective q := (show Function.LeftInverse r q from hrq).injective

    let mapGate (g : Gate) : Gate := ⟨g.op, g.inputs.map q⟩
    let oldG := C.gates.map mapGate
    let pad : Gate := ⟨.and, [0,13]⟩
    let D : Circuit :=
      ⟨oldG ++ List.replicate (63 - C.gates.length) pad, q C.output⟩
    let n := 26 + C.gates.length
    have dlen : D.gates.length = C.gates.length + (63 - C.gates.length) := by
      simp [D, oldG]
    have read_mapped (j : ℕ) (g : Gate) (hg : C.gates[j]? = some g)
        (hj : j < C.gates.length) : D.gates[j]? = some (mapGate g) := by
      change (oldG ++ _)[j]? = _
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by simpa only [oldG, List.length_map] using hj)]
      simp only [oldG, List.getElem?_map, hg, Option.map_some]
    have read_pad (j : ℕ) (g : Gate) (hg : D.gates[j]? = some g)
        (hj : C.gates.length ≤ j) : g = pad := by
      change (oldG ++ _)[j]? = _ at hg
      rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by simpa only [oldG, List.length_map] using hj),
        List.getElem?_replicate] at hg
      split at hg
      · exact (Option.some.inj hg).symm
      · cases hg
    have hD : Valid 26 D := by
      intro j g hg
      by_cases hj : j < C.gates.length
      · let g₀ := C.gates[j]
        have hg₀ : C.gates[j]? = some g₀ := List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj
        have heq := Option.some.inj (hg.symm.trans (read_mapped j g₀ hg₀ hj))
        subst g
        obtain ⟨hop, a, b, hin, hne, ha, hb⟩ := hC j g₀ hg₀
        refine ⟨hop, q a, q b, ?_, fun h => hne (hqinj h), ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [mapGate, hin, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
        · exact (label_lt e a _ (by omega)).mpr ha
        · exact (label_lt e b _ (by omega)).mpr hb
      · have heq := read_pad j g hg (by omega)
        subst g
        exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, 0, 13, rfl, by decide, by omega, by omega⟩

    have eval_at (x : Fin 26 → Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
        val D x (q i) = val C (fun j => x (e j)) i := by
      induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | ind i ih =>
        by_cases hi₀ : i < 26
        · have hqi : q i < 26 := (label_lt e i 26 (le_refl _)).mpr hi₀
          rw [val_input D x _ hqi, val_input C _ _ hi₀]
          congr 1
          exact Fin.ext (label_input e (⟨i,hi₀⟩ : Fin 26))
        · let j := i - 26
          have heq : i = 26 + j := by dsimp [j]; omega
          have hj : j < C.gates.length := by dsimp [n] at hi; omega
          let g := C.gates[j]
          have hg : C.gates[j]? = some g := List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj
          obtain ⟨hop, a, b, hin, _, ha, hb⟩ := hC j g hg
          have ha' := (label_lt e a (26+j) (by omega)).mpr ha
          have hb' := (label_lt e b (26+j) (by omega)).mpr hb
          have hm : (mapGate g).inputs = [q a,q b] := by
            simp only [mapGate, hin, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
          have h₀ := val_gate C (fun k => x (e k)) j g hg a b hin ha hb
          have h₁ := val_gate D x j (mapGate g) (read_mapped j g hg hj) (q a) (q b) hm ha' hb'
          clear hm
          rw [heq, show q (26 + j) = 26 + j from label_gate e (by omega)]
          have ea := ih a (by omega) (by omega)
          have eb := ih b (by omega) (by omega)
          rcases hop with h | h
          · rw [h₁.1 h, h₀.1 h, ea, eb]
          · rw [h₁.2 h, h₀.2 h, ea, eb]

    have hout : C.output < n := by
      have hrow : val C (fun _ : Fin 26 => true) C.output = true :=
        (hI _).mpr ⟨0, 0, by decide, rfl, rfl⟩
      by_contra! h
      exact Bool.noConfusion (hrow.symm.trans (val_outside C _ C.output h))
    have hDI : Computes D := by
      intro x
      change val D x (q C.output) = true ↔ _
      rw [eval_at x _ hout]
      change C.eval (List.ofFn fun j => x (e j)) = true ↔ _
      rw [hI (fun j => x (e j))]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨u,t,hut,hu,ht⟩
        rw [heP] at hu
        rw [heL] at ht
        exact ⟨α u, β t, (hab u t).mpr hut, hu, ht⟩
      · rintro ⟨u,t,hut,hu,ht⟩
        refine ⟨α.symm u, β.symm t, (hab _ _).mp ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hut
        · simpa only [heP, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hu
        · simpa only [heL, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using ht

    have transportTrace (other repeated : Fin 26) (T : ℕ → Bool)
        (hT : LinearTrace 26 C other.val repeated.val T) :
        ∃ T', LinearTrace 26 D (e other).val (e repeated).val T' ∧
          T' D.output = T C.output := by
      let V := val D (oneInput 26 (e other).val)
      let T' (i : ℕ) :=
        if i < n then T (r i) else (V 0 && T (r 13)) || (T (r 0) && V 13)
      have at_old (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) : T' (q i) = T i := by
        have hqi := (label_lt e i n (by dsimp [n]; omega)).mpr hi
        change (if q i < n then T (r (q i)) else _) = T i
        rw [ite_eq_left hqi, hrq]
      have at_input (i : ℕ) (hi : i < 26) : T' i = T (r i) := by
        have hin : i < n := by dsimp [n]; omega
        simp only [T', ite_eq_left hin]
      have pull : (fun i : Fin 26 => oneInput 26 (e other).val (e i)) = oneInput 26 other.val := by
        funext i
        simp only [oneInput, Fin.val_inj, Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]
      have val_at_old (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
          V (q i) = val C (oneInput 26 other.val) i := by
        change val D (oneInput 26 (e other).val) (q i) = _
        rw [eval_at _ _ hi, pull]
      refine ⟨T', ⟨?_, ?_⟩, at_old _ hout⟩
      · intro i hi
        have hri := (label_lt e.symm i 26 (le_refl _)).mpr hi
        rw [at_input i hi, hT.1 _ hri]
        have hp : r i = repeated.val ↔ i = (e repeated).val := by
          have hlabel : q repeated.val = (e repeated).val := label_input e repeated
          constructor
          · intro h
            exact (hqr i).symm.trans ((congrArg q h).trans hlabel)
          · intro h
            rw [h.trans hlabel.symm, hrq]
        change decide (r i = repeated.val) = decide (i = (e repeated).val)
        simp only [hp]
      · intro j g a b hg hab'
        by_cases hj : j < C.gates.length
        · let g₀ := C.gates[j]
          have hg₀ : C.gates[j]? = some g₀ := List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj
          have heq := Option.some.inj (hg.symm.trans (read_mapped j g₀ hg₀ hj))
          subst g
          obtain ⟨_, a₀, b₀, h₀, _, ha₀, hb₀⟩ := hC j g₀ hg₀
          have hi : q a₀ = a ∧ q b₀ = b := by
            simpa only [mapGate, h₀, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.cons.injEq, and_true] using hab'
          obtain ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ := hi
          have hjn : 26+j < n := by dsimp [n]; omega
          have han : a₀ < n := by omega
          have hbn : b₀ < n := by omega
          have htj : T' (26+j) = T (26+j) := by
            simpa only [q, label_gate e (show 26 ≤ 26+j by omega)] using at_old (26+j) hjn
          change ((g₀.op = .and → T' (26+j) = (V (q a₀) && T' (q b₀) ||
            T' (q a₀) && V (q b₀))) ∧
            (g₀.op = .or → T' (26+j) = (T' (q a₀) || T' (q b₀))))
          rw [htj, at_old _ han, at_old _ hbn, val_at_old _ han, val_at_old _ hbn]
          exact hT.2 j g₀ a₀ b₀ hg₀ h₀
        · have heq := read_pad j g hg (by omega)
          subst g
          have hi : (0 : ℕ) = a ∧ (13 : ℕ) = b := by
            simpa only [pad, List.cons.injEq, and_true] using hab'
          obtain ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ := hi
          refine ⟨fun _ => ?_, by simp [pad]⟩
          have hjn : ¬(26+j) < n := by dsimp [n]; omega
          change T' (26+j) = (V 0 && T' 13 || T' 0 && V 13)
          rw [at_input 0 (by decide), at_input 13 (by decide)]
          simp only [T', ite_eq_right hjn]

    have pointNorm : e (Fin.castAdd 13 p) = Fin.castAdd 13 0 := by rw [heP, hα]
    have lineNorm : e (Fin.natAdd 13 l) = Fin.natAdd 13 (0 : Fin 13) := by rw [heL, hβ]
    have r' := transportTrace (Fin.castAdd 13 p) (Fin.natAdd 13 l) R hR
    have s' := transportTrace (Fin.natAdd 13 l) (Fin.castAdd 13 p) S hS
    rw [pointNorm, lineNorm] at r' s'
    change C.gates.length ≤ 64 at hmax
    refine ⟨D, ?_, ?_, hD, hDI, r', s'⟩
    · change 63 ≤ D.gates.length
      omega
    · change D.gates.length ≤ 64
      omega

  let linearOp (op : GateOp) (ins : List (Bool × Bool)) : Bool × Bool :=
    GateOp.rec (motive := fun _ => Bool × Bool)
      (ins.foldl (fun acc p =>
        (acc.1 && p.1, (acc.1 && p.2) || (acc.2 && p.1))) (true, false))
      (ins.any (·.1), ins.any (·.2)) (false,false) (fun _ => (false,false))
      (false,false) op

  have lineSingle_eq_trace (n : ℕ) (C : Circuit) (hC : Valid n C) (other repeated : ℕ)
      (hne : other ≠ repeated) (R : ℕ → Bool) (hR : LinearTrace n C other repeated R)
      (hout : C.output < n + C.gates.length) :
      PEqualNP.ReadK.lineSingle C n (fun i => decide (i = repeated)) other repeated = R C.output := by
    let x := (List.range n).map fun i => i == other || i == repeated
    let start : List (Bool × Bool) :=
      (x.zipIdx).map fun bi => if decide (bi.2 = repeated) then (false,bi.1) else (bi.1,false)
    let W := C.gates.foldl (gateStep linearOp (false,false)) start
    let S := val C (oneInput n other)
    have hlen : start.length = n := by simp [start, x]
    have hparts : ∀ i < n + C.gates.length,
        (W.getD i (false,false)).1 = S i ∧ (W.getD i (false,false)).2 = R i := by
      intro i
      induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | ind i ih =>
        intro hi
        by_cases hin : i < n
        · have hi' : i < start.length := by rwa [hlen]
          have hx : i < x.length := by simpa [x] using hin
          have hx' : x[i] = (i == other || i == repeated) := by simp [x]
          have h0 : (W.getD i (false,false)) =
              (if decide (i = repeated) then (false,x[i]) else (x[i],false)) := by

  have lowerFour (C : Circuit) (hg : G C) (he : E C)

  -- Wire relabeling follows the argument in R_meta_1482_2.
  have getD_rel : ∀ (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (hl : ∀ a, a < 26 → ρ a < 26) (hb : ∀ a, 26 ≤ a → ρ a = a)

            exact ⟨u, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ u, he⟩, rfl⟩
        have hNne : N.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [hNcard]; exact hE1.card_pos)
        have horN := hbld_orFinset N hNne
        have handN := hbld_bin PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and (Or.inl rfl)
          (fun x => x t) (fun x => decide (∃ u ∈ N, x u = true)) 0 (N.card - 1) (hbld_var t) horN
        have hNpos : 0 < N.card := hNne.card_pos
        refine hbld_congr _ _ E1.card (hbld_mono _ _ _ handN (by omega)) ?_
        intro x
        rw [hand_eval]
        apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
        constructor
        · intro h
          rcases h with ⟨hxt, u, huN, hxu⟩
          have huE1 : s(t, u) ∈ E1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp huN).2
          refine ⟨s(t, u), huE1, ?_⟩
          intro v hv
          rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hv with rfl | rfl
          · exact hxt
          · exact hxu
        · intro h
          rcases h with ⟨e, he1, hxe⟩
          have hte : t ∈ e := (Finset.mem_filter.mp he1).2
          rcases Sym2.mem_iff_exists.mp hte with ⟨u, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨hxe t (Sym2.mem_mk_left t u), u,
            Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ u, he1⟩, hxe u (Sym2.mem_mk_right t u)⟩
      have hkey : ∀ x : Fin n → Bool,
          decide (∃ e ∈ E, ∀ v ∈ e, x v = true) =
            (decide (∃ e ∈ E1, ∀ v ∈ e, x v = true) || decide (∃ e ∈ E2, ∀ v ∈ e, x v = true)) := by
        intro x
        apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
        constructor
        · intro h
          rcases h with ⟨e, he, hxe⟩
          by_cases hte : t ∈ e
          · exact Or.inl ⟨e, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he, hte⟩, hxe⟩
          · exact Or.inr ⟨e, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he, hte⟩, hxe⟩
        · intro h
          rcases h with ⟨e, he, hxe⟩ | ⟨e, he, hxe⟩
          · exact ⟨e, (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).1, hxe⟩
          · exact ⟨e, (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).1, hxe⟩
      by_cases h1 : E1.Nonempty
      · by_cases h2 : E2.Nonempty
        · have hb1 := hstar h1
          have hb2 := ih E2 h2 hnd2 hcov2
          have hor12 := hbld_bin PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or (Or.inr rfl) _ _ _ _ hb1 hb2
          have hp2 : 0 < E2.card := h2.card_pos
          refine hbld_congr _ _ _ (hbld_mono _ _ _ hor12 (by omega)) (fun x => ?_)
          rw [hor_eval, hkey x]
        · have hE2e : E2 = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h2
          have hE1c : E1.card = E.card := by rw [hE2e, Finset.card_empty] at hsplit; omega
          refine hbld_congr _ _ _ (hbld_mono _ _ _ (hstar h1) (by omega)) (fun x => ?_)
          rw [hkey x, hE2e]; simp
      · have hE1e : E1 = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h1
        have hE2c : E2.card = E.card := by rw [hE1e, Finset.card_empty] at hsplit; omega
        have h2 : E2.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [hE2c]; exact hE.card_pos)
        refine hbld_congr _ _ _ (hbld_mono _ _ _ (ih E2 h2 hnd2 hcov2) (by omega)) (fun x => ?_)
        rw [hkey x, hE1e]; simp
  -- Part 2: If a vertex cover T of G satisfies A.card + G.edgeFinset.card + T.card ≤ C.size + 1,
  -- then deleting any z ∈ T \ A gives a circuit of size ≤ C.size - 4.
  have hcover_solve : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n),
      (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → u ∈ T ∨ v ∈ T) →
      A.card + G.edgeFinset.card + T.card ≤ C.size + 1 →
      ∃ z ∉ A, ∃ s, s + 4 ≤ C.size ∧
        PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n (fun x => f (Function.update x z false)) s := by
    intro T hcov hle
    rcases hedge with ⟨u0, v0, huv0⟩
    have hz_ex : ∃ z : Fin n, z ∈ T ∧ z ∉ A := by
      rcases hcov u0 v0 huv0 with hu | hv
      · exact ⟨u0, hu, hnoA u0 v0 huv0⟩
      · exact ⟨v0, hv, hnoA v0 u0 huv0.symm⟩
    rcases hz_ex with ⟨z, hzT, hzA⟩
    let G' := G.deleteEdges (G.incidenceSet z)
    let T' := T.erase z
    have hdegz : G.degree z = 3 := by
      rw [← G.ncard_neighborSet]
      exact hdeg z hzA
    have hnz_pos : 0 < (G.neighborFinset z).card := by
      rw [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hdegz]; omega
    rcases Finset.card_pos.mp hnz_pos with ⟨w, hw⟩
    have hzw : G.Adj z w := (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset G z w).mp hw
    have hwA : w ∉ A := hnoA w z hzw.symm
    have hdegw : G.degree w = 3 := by
      rw [← G.ncard_neighborSet]
      exact hdeg w hwA
    have hnw_gt : 1 < (G.neighborFinset w).card := by
      rw [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hdegw]; omega
    have hw_ex : ∃ w' : Fin n, w' ∈ G.neighborFinset w ∧ w' ≠ z := by
      by_contra hno
      push Not at hno
      have hsub : G.neighborFinset w ⊆ {z} := by
        intro y hy
        exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr (hno y hy)
      have hc := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      simp at hc
      omega
    rcases hw_ex with ⟨w', hw', hw'z⟩
    have hww' : G.Adj w w' := (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset G w w').mp hw'
    have hG'adj : ∀ u v : Fin n, G'.Adj u v ↔ G.Adj u v ∧ u ≠ z ∧ v ≠ z :=
      fun u v => SimpleGraph.deleteIncidenceSet_adj
    have hG'edge : G'.Adj w w' := (hG'adj w w').mpr ⟨hww', hzw.ne.symm, hw'z⟩
    have hG'ne : G'.edgeFinset.Nonempty := ⟨s(w, w'), by simpa using hG'edge⟩
    have hG'card : G'.edgeFinset.card = G.edgeFinset.card - 3 := by
      have h1 := G.card_edgeFinset_deleteIncidenceSet z
      rw [hdegz] at h1
      exact h1
    have hEge4 : 4 ≤ G.edgeFinset.card := by
      have hpos : 0 < G'.edgeFinset.card := hG'ne.card_pos
      omega
    have hT'card : T'.card = T.card - 1 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hzT
    have hTpos : 1 ≤ T.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨z, hzT⟩
    have hcov' : ∀ e ∈ G'.edgeFinset, ∃ t ∈ T', t ∈ e := by
      intro e
      refine Sym2.ind (fun u v => ?_) e
      intro he
      rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset, SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] at he
      have h1 := (hG'adj u v).mp he
      rcases hcov u v h1.1 with hu | hv
      · exact ⟨u, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨h1.2.1, hu⟩, Sym2.mem_mk_left u v⟩
      · exact ⟨v, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨h1.2.2, hv⟩, Sym2.mem_mk_right u v⟩
    have hnd' : ∀ e ∈ G'.edgeFinset, ¬e.IsDiag := by
      intro e he
      exact G'.not_isDiag_of_mem_edgeSet (SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset.mp he)
    have hbE := hbld_edges T' G'.edgeFinset hG'ne hnd' hcov'
    have hfun_eq : ∀ x : Fin n → Bool,
        f (Function.update x z false) =
          (decide (∃ a ∈ A, x a = true) || decide (∃ e ∈ G'.edgeFinset, ∀ v ∈ e, x v = true)) := by
      intro x
      apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
      rw [hf_iff]
      simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      constructor
      · intro h
        rcases h with ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩ | ⟨u, v, huv, hxu, hxv⟩
        · have haz : a ≠ z := fun he => hzA (he ▸ ha)
          rw [Function.update_of_ne haz] at hxa
          exact Or.inl ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩
        · have huz : u ≠ z := by intro he; rw [he, Function.update_self] at hxu; exact Bool.false_ne_true hxu
          have hvz : v ≠ z := by intro he; rw [he, Function.update_self] at hxv; exact Bool.false_ne_true hxv
          rw [Function.update_of_ne huz] at hxu
          rw [Function.update_of_ne hvz] at hxv
          refine Or.inr ⟨s(u, v), ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset, SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet]
            exact (hG'adj u v).mpr ⟨huv, huz, hvz⟩
          · intro y hy
            rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hy with rfl | rfl
            · exact hxu
            · exact hxv
      · intro h
        rcases h with ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩ | ⟨e, he, hxe⟩
        · have haz : a ≠ z := fun he => hzA (he ▸ ha)
          exact Or.inl ⟨a, ha, by rw [Function.update_of_ne haz]; exact hxa⟩
        · revert he hxe
          refine Sym2.ind (fun u v => ?_) e
          intro he hxe
          rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset, SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] at he
          have h1 := (hG'adj u v).mp he
          exact Or.inr ⟨u, v, h1.1,
            by rw [Function.update_of_ne h1.2.1]; exact hxe u (Sym2.mem_mk_left u v),
            by rw [Function.update_of_ne h1.2.2]; exact hxe v (Sym2.mem_mk_right u v)⟩
    have hb_all : Bld (fun x => f (Function.update x z false))
        (A.card + G'.edgeFinset.card + T'.card - 1) := by
      by_cases hA : A.Nonempty
      · have hbA := hbld_orFinset A hA
        have horA := hbld_bin PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or (Or.inr rfl) _ _ _ _ hbA hbE
        have hAp : 0 < A.card := hA.card_pos
        have hEp : 0 < G'.edgeFinset.card := hG'ne.card_pos
        refine hbld_congr _ _ _ (hbld_mono _ _ _ horA (by omega)) (fun x => ?_)
        rw [hor_eval, ← hfun_eq x]
      · have hAe : A = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hA
        refine hbld_congr _ _ _ (hbld_mono _ _ _ hbE (by simp [hAe])) (fun x => ?_)
        rw [hfun_eq x, hAe]; simp
    refine ⟨z, hzA, A.card + G'.edgeFinset.card + T'.card - 1, ?_, hbld_hasSize _ _ hb_all⟩
    omega
  -- Part 3: If some cover T satisfies the bound, solve immediately.
  by_cases hcov_small : ∃ T : Finset (Fin n),
      (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → u ∈ T ∨ v ∈ T) ∧
      A.card + G.edgeFinset.card + T.card ≤ C.size + 1
  · rcases hcov_small with ⟨T, hcov, hle⟩
    exact hcover_solve T hcov hle
  have htight : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n), (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → u ∈ T ∨ v ∈ T) →
      C.size + 1 < A.card + G.edgeFinset.card + T.card := by
    intro T hcov
    have hnot_le : ¬ (A.card + G.edgeFinset.card + T.card ≤ C.size + 1) :=
      fun hle => hcov_small ⟨T, hcov, hle⟩
    omega
  -- Part 4: Slot counting proves A.card + 2 * Aᶜ.card ≤ C.size + 1, ruling out G.Colorable 2.
  have hnot_bip : ¬ G.Colorable 2 := by
    intro hcol
    rcases hcol with ⟨col⟩
    let L : Finset (Fin n) := Aᶜ.filter (fun v => col v = 0)
    let R : Finset (Fin n) := Aᶜ.filter (fun v => col v = 1)
    have hLR_sum : L.card + R.card = Aᶜ.card := by
      have hdisj : Disjoint L R := by
        rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
        intro v hvL hvR
        have h0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvL).2
        have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvR).2
        rw [h0] at h1
        exact absurd h1 (by decide)
      have hunion : L ∪ R = Aᶜ := by
        ext v
        simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, L, R]
        constructor
        · intro h; rcases h with ⟨hv, _⟩ | ⟨hv, _⟩ <;> exact hv
        · intro hv
          have hcv := (col v).isLt
          have h01 : col v = 0 ∨ col v = 1 := by
            rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hcv with hlt | heq
            · left; exact Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hlt)
            · right; exact Fin.ext heq
          rcases h01 with h0 | h1
          · exact Or.inl ⟨hv, h0⟩
          · exact Or.inr ⟨hv, h1⟩
      rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, hunion]
    have hcovL : ∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → u ∈ L ∨ v ∈ L := by
      intro u v huv
      have huA : u ∈ Aᶜ := Finset.mem_compl.mpr (hnoA u v huv)
      have hvA : v ∈ Aᶜ := Finset.mem_compl.mpr (hnoA v u huv.symm)
      have hne : col u ≠ col v := col.valid huv
      have hcu : col u = 0 ∨ col u = 1 := by
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (col u).isLt with hlt | heq
        · left; exact Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hlt)
        · right; exact Fin.ext heq
      have hcv : col v = 0 ∨ col v = 1 := by
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (col v).isLt with hlt | heq
        · left; exact Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hlt)
        · right; exact Fin.ext heq
      rcases hcu with hu0 | hu1
      · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨huA, hu0⟩)
      · rcases hcv with hv0 | hv1
        · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hvA, hv0⟩)
        · exact absurd (hu1.trans hv1.symm) hne
    have hcovR : ∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → u ∈ R ∨ v ∈ R := by
      intro u v huv
      have huA : u ∈ Aᶜ := Finset.mem_compl.mpr (hnoA u v huv)
      have hvA : v ∈ Aᶜ := Finset.mem_compl.mpr (hnoA v u huv.symm)
      have hne : col u ≠ col v := col.valid huv
      have hcu : col u = 0 ∨ col u = 1 := by
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (col u).isLt with hlt | heq
        · left; exact Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hlt)
        · right; exact Fin.ext heq
      have hcv : col v = 0 ∨ col v = 1 := by
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (col v).isLt with hlt | heq
        · left; exact Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hlt)
        · right; exact Fin.ext heq
      rcases hcu with hu0 | hu1
      · rcases hcv with hv0 | hv1
        · exact absurd (hu0.trans hv0.symm) hne
        · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hvA, hv1⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨huA, hu1⟩)
    -- Slot counting on C:
    let slots : List ℕ := C.output :: C.gates.flatMap PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate.inputs
    let cnt : ℕ → ℕ := fun i => slots.count i
    have hwires_agree : ∀ (gs : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (b : ℕ)
        (w1 w2 : List Bool), w1.length = w2.length → b < w1.length →
        (∀ i, i ≠ b → w1.getD i false = w2.getD i false) →
        (∀ g ∈ gs, b ∉ g.inputs) →
        (runW gs w1).length = (runW gs w2).length ∧
        ∀ i, i ≠ b → (runW gs w1).getD i false = (runW gs w2).getD i false := by
      intro gs
      induction gs with
      | nil => intro b w1 w2 hl _ ha _; exact ⟨hl, ha⟩
      | cons g gs ih =>
        intro b w1 w2 hl hb ha hno
        rw [hrun_cons, hrun_cons]
        have hmap : (g.inputs.map (fun i => w1.getD i false)) =
            (g.inputs.map (fun i => w2.getD i false)) := by
          apply List.map_congr_left
          intro i hi
          exact ha i (fun he => hno g List.mem_cons_self (he ▸ hi))
        apply ih b (step w1 g) (step w2 g)
        · simp [step, hl]
        · simp [step]; omega
        · intro i hib
          dsimp only [step]
          rw [hmap]
          by_cases hlt : i < w1.length
          · rw [hgetD_snoc_lt w1 _ i hlt, hgetD_snoc_lt w2 _ i (by omega)]
            exact ha i hib
          · by_cases heq : i = w1.length
            · subst heq
              rw [hgetD_snoc_eq w1, hl, hgetD_snoc_eq w2]
            · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by simp; omega),
                  List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by simp; omega)]
        · intro g' hg'; exact hno g' (List.mem_cons_of_mem g hg')
    have hmarked : ∀ a ∈ A, 1 ≤ cnt a.val := by
      intro a ha
      apply List.count_pos_iff.mpr
      by_contra hns
      have hout : C.output ≠ a.val := fun he => hns (by simp [slots, he])
      have hno : ∀ g ∈ C.gates, a.val ∉ g.inputs := fun g hg hi =>
        hns (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨g, hg, hi⟩))
      let z0 : Fin n → Bool := fun _ => false
      let y0 : Fin n → Bool := fun i => decide (i = a)
      have hagr := (hwires_agree C.gates a.val (List.ofFn z0) (List.ofFn y0)
        (by simp) (by simp) (by
          intro i hia
          by_cases hi : i < n
          · rw [hofFn_getD z0 i hi, hofFn_getD y0 i hi]
            have hne : (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin n) ≠ a := fun he => hia (congrArg Fin.val he)
            simp [z0, y0, hne]
          · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by simp; omega),
                List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by simp; omega)]) hno).2 C.output hout
      have hcz : f z0 = (runW C.gates (List.ofFn z0)).getD C.output false := by
        rw [← hcircuitFun_eq C z0, heval]
      have hcy : f y0 = (runW C.gates (List.ofFn y0)).getD C.output false := by
        rw [← hcircuitFun_eq C y0, heval]
      have hfz : f z0 ≠ true := by
        intro ht
        rcases (hf_iff z0).mp ht with ⟨_, _, h⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, h, _⟩ <;> exact Bool.false_ne_true h
      have hfy : f y0 = true := (hf_iff y0).mpr (Or.inl ⟨a, ha, by simp [y0]⟩)
      exact hfz ((hcz.trans hagr).trans hcy.symm |>.trans hfy)
    have hfiltered : ∀ (v : ℕ) (gs : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate),
        (gs.filter (fun g =>
          (List.take (bif g.op.eval [false] then 1 else 2) g.inputs).contains v)).length ≤
        (gs.flatMap PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate.inputs).count v := by
      intro v gs
      induction gs with
      | nil => simp
      | cons g gs ih =>
        simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.count_append, List.filter_cons]
        split
        next h =>
          have hm : v ∈ g.inputs := List.mem_of_mem_take (List.contains_iff_mem.mp h)
          have hp := List.count_pos_iff.mpr hm
          simp only [List.length_cons]
          omega
        next => omega
    have hunmarked : ∀ v ∈ Aᶜ, 2 ≤ cnt v.val := by
      intro v hv
      have h2 := (hread v (Finset.mem_compl.mp hv)).1
      have h1 := hfiltered v.val C.gates
      simp only [cnt, slots, List.count_cons]
      omega
    have hinternal : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range C.gates.length, 1 ≤ cnt (n + i) := by
      intro i hi
      have hilt : i < C.gates.length := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      apply List.count_pos_iff.mpr
      by_contra hns
      have hout : C.output ≠ n + i := fun he => hns (by simp [slots, he])
      have hno : ∀ g ∈ C.gates, n + i ∉ g.inputs := fun g hg hm =>
        hns (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨g, hg, hm⟩))
      -- Delete dead gate i by shifting all wire indices > n + i down by 1.
      let del : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => if j < n + i then j else j - 1
      let delG : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate := fun g =>
        ⟨g.op, g.inputs.map del⟩
      let gs1 := C.gates.take i
      let gs2 := C.gates.drop (i + 1)
      let gs' := gs1 ++ gs2.map delG
      have hsplit : C.gates = gs1 ++ C.gates[i] :: gs2 := by
        have h1 := (List.take_append_drop i C.gates).symm
        rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hilt] at h1
        exact h1
      have hdel_sim : ∀ (gs : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (w1 w2 : List Bool),
          w1.length = w2.length + 1 → n + i < w1.length →
          (∀ j, j ≠ n + i → j < w1.length → w2.getD (del j) false = w1.getD j false) →
          (∀ g ∈ gs, n + i ∉ g.inputs) →
          (runW gs w1).length = (runW (gs.map delG) w2).length + 1 ∧
          (∀ j, j ≠ n + i → j < (runW gs w1).length →
            (runW (gs.map delG) w2).getD (del j) false = (runW gs w1).getD j false) := by
        intro gs
        induction gs with
        | nil => intro w1 w2 hl _ ha _; exact ⟨hl, ha⟩
        | cons g gs ih =>
          intro w1 w2 hl hni ha hnog
          rw [List.map_cons, hrun_cons, hrun_cons]
          have hmap : ((delG g).inputs.map (fun j => w2.getD j false)) =
              (g.inputs.map (fun j => w1.getD j false)) := by
            change ((g.inputs.map del).map (fun j => w2.getD j false)) = _
            rw [List.map_map]
            apply List.map_congr_left
            intro j hj
            change w2.getD (del j) false = w1.getD j false

          obtain ⟨w, hw, heq⟩ := hsurj w' hw'
          exact ⟨w, by omega, heq⟩
        · intro k b hk htwo hnd
          by_cases hkt : k < t
          · have hne : N + N + k ≠ N + N + t := by omega
            obtain ⟨j, hj, hmpj, hndj⟩ := hdirty k b hkt htwo hnd

      have keep_step (a' c' : ℕ) (hne' : a' ≠ c') (hmax' : max a' c' < N + N + m)

            (∀ w < N + N + (t + 1), (mp1 w = none → W w = ∅) ∧

            (∀ j < m1, ∃ a c, a ≠ c ∧ max a c < N + N + j ∧

                ¬∃ a < N + N + j, ∃ c < N + N + j, oh W'1 b (N + N + j) = oh W'1 b a ∪ oh W'1 b c) := by
        let W'1 : ℕ → Set ((Fin N → Bool) × (Fin N → Bool)) :=
          fun w => if w = N + N + m then W (N + N + t) else W' w
        let mp1 : ℕ → Option ℕ :=

          simp only [W'1, hne, ↓reduceIte]

          simp only [W'1, ↓reduceIte]

        · intro w hw
          have hne : w ≠ N + N + t := by omega
          simp only [mp1, hne, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [hW'1_old w (by omega)]
          exact hin' w hw
        · intro w hw
          by_cases hweq : w = N + N + t
          · subst hweq
            simp only [mp1, ↓reduceIte]
            refine ⟨fun h => (by cases h), fun w' h => ?_⟩
            cases h
            exact ⟨by omega, hW'1_new⟩
          · simp only [mp1, hweq, ↓reduceIte]
            have h := hmp w (by omega)
            refine ⟨h.1, fun w' hmw => ?_⟩
            obtain ⟨hw'lt, hw'eq⟩ := h.2 w' hmw
            exact ⟨by omega, (hW'1_old w' hw'lt).trans hw'eq⟩
        · intro w' hw'
          by_cases hw'm : w' < N + N + m
          · obtain ⟨w, hw, heq⟩ := hsurj w' hw'm

          · have hweq : w' = N + N + m := by omega
            subst hweq
            exact ⟨N + N + t, by omega, hW'1_new⟩
        · intro j hj
          by_cases hjm : j < m
          · obtain ⟨a1, c1, hne1, hmax1, hmem1⟩ := hbin j hjm
            have ha1 : a1 < N + N + m := by omega
            have hc1 : c1 < N + N + m := by omega
            refine ⟨a1, c1, hne1, hmax1, ?_⟩
            rw [hW'1_old (N + N + j) (by omega), hW'1_old a1 ha1, hW'1_old c1 hc1]
            exact hmem1
          · have hjeq : j = m := by omega
            rw [hjeq]
            have ha' : a' < N + N + m := by omega
            have hc' : c' < N + N + m := by omega
            refine ⟨a', c', hne', hmax', ?_⟩

          by_cases hkt : k < t
          · have hne : N + N + k ≠ N + N + t := by omega
            obtain ⟨j, hj, hmpj, hndj⟩ := hdirty k b hkt htwo hnd
            refine ⟨j, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
            · simp only [mp1, hne, ↓reduceIte]

            · rintro ⟨a1, ha1, c1, hc1, heq⟩
              apply hndj
              refine ⟨a1, ha1, c1, hc1, ?_⟩
              rw [hoh_eq W' W'1 b (N + N + j) (N + N + j) (hW'1_old _ (by omega)).symm,

              exact heq

      have ha : a < N + N + t := by omega
      have hc : c < N + N + t := by omega

      have hmc := hmp c hc

          exact ⟨fun h => hWeq.trans (hmc.1 h), fun c' h => ⟨(hmc.2 c' h).1, (hmc.2 c' h).2.trans hWeq.symm⟩⟩

          | none =>

            cases h

          obtain ⟨ha'lt, ha'eq⟩ := hma.2 a' hmpa

          | none =>
            have hWc : W c = ∅ := hmc.1 hmpc
            exact skip_step none ⟨fun _ => by rw [hI, hWc, Set.inter_empty], fun _ h => by cases h⟩
          | some c' =>
            obtain ⟨hc'lt, hc'eq⟩ := hmc.2 c' hmpc
            by_cases hac' : a' = c'
            · apply skip_step (some a')
              refine ⟨fun h => (by cases h), fun w' h => ?_⟩
              cases h
              refine ⟨ha'lt, ?_⟩
              rw [hI, ← ha'eq, ← hc'eq, hac', Set.inter_self]

              simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
              exact Or.inr (by rw [hI, ← ha'eq, ← hc'eq])

    have hoh_out_true : oh W' true out' = ∅ := by

      Monotone2 F ∧ ReadsBack 26 F ∧ computesIncidence F ∧ F.size = n :=
    ⟨E.size, E, emono, eback, eComputes, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F, fmono, fback, fvalue, fsize⟩ := Nat.find_spec existsSize
  have smallest (G : Circuit) (mono : Monotone2 G) (reads : ReadsBack 26 G)
      (value : computesIncidence G) : F.size ≤ G.size := by
    rw [fsize]
    exact Nat.find_min' existsSize ⟨G, mono, reads, value, rfl⟩
  rw [← sameSize]
  apply Nat.le_trans _ (smallest E emono eback eComputes)
  by_cases nest : ∃ i j : ℕ,
      (gateAt F i).op = GateOp.and ∧ (gateAt F j).op = GateOp.and ∧ InCone 26 F i j
  · exact nested F fmono fback fvalue smallest nest
  · apply depthOne F fmono fback _ nest
    constructor
    · intro p l inc
      rw [← List.ofFn_fin_append]
      exact (fvalue _).2 ⟨p, l, inc, by simp only [Fin.append_left, decide_true],
        by simp only [Fin.append_right, decide_true]⟩
    · intro S _ _
      rw [← List.ofFn_fin_append]
      apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
      intro accepted
      obtain ⟨p, l, inc, hp, hl⟩ := (fvalue _).1 accepted
      rw [Fin.append_left, decide_eq_true_eq] at hp
      rw [Fin.append_right, decide_eq_true_eq] at hl
      exact hl p hp inc
